paracetamol.name: Paracetamol / Acetaminophen
paracetamol.uses: Pain relief, fever reduction, headache, muscle aches
paracetamol.warning: Do not exceed recommended dose. Avoid with alcohol.

ibuprofen.name: Ibuprofen
ibuprofen.uses: Pain relief, inflammation, fever, arthritis, muscle pain
ibuprofen.side_effects: Stomach upset, heartburn, dizziness, kidney issues
ibuprofen.warning: Take with food. Not for long-term use. Avoid with stomach ulcers.

aspirin.name: Aspirin (Acetylsalicylic Acid)
aspirin.uses: Pain relief, fever, blood thinning, heart attack prevention
aspirin.side_effects: Stomach irritation, bleeding risk, ringing in ears
aspirin.warning: Not for children under 16. Avoid with stomach ulcers.

amoxicillin.name: Amoxicillin
amoxicillin.warning: Complete full course. Allergies possible (rash, swelling).

azithromycin.name: Azithromycin
azithromycin.uses: Bacterial infections (respiratory, sinus, ear, skin, STD)
azithromycin.dosage: 500mg once daily (3-day course) or 1g single dose
azithromycin.warning: Take on empty stomach. Avoid with heart rhythm problems.

metformin.name: Metformin
metformin.side_effects: Nausea, diarrhea, stomach upset, vitamin B12 deficiency
metformin.warning: Take with food. Monitor kidney function. Avoid alcohol.

omeprazole.name: Omeprazole
omeprazole.uses: Acid reflux, heartburn, GERD, stomach ulcers
omeprazole.side_effects: Headache, nausea, constipation, vitamin B12 deficiency
omeprazole.warning: Short-term use recommended. May affect vitamin B12 absorption.

losartan.name: Losartan
losartan.uses: High blood pressure, kidney protection in diabetes
losartan.warning: Monitor blood pressure. Avoid during pregnancy.

amlodipine.name: Amlodipine
amlodipine.warning: Take same time daily. Avoid grapefruit juice.

atorvastatin.name: Atorvastatin
atorvastatin.side_effects: Muscle pain, joint pain, diarrhea, liver issues
atorvastatin.warning: Monitor liver function. Report muscle pain. Avoid pregnancy.

levothyroxine.name: Levothyroxine
levothyroxine.side_effects: Weight loss, nervousness, heart palpitations, insomnia
levothyroxine.warning: Take on empty stomach 30-60 min before breakfast. Regular blood tests.
